realSourceCause: Normal build-mac entry copied the complete builder App into a temporary folder via ditto before hdiutil. This adds another logical full App copy to an already disk-limited build. Local cp(1) says -c can silently fall back to copyfile, and ditto --clone only attempts cloning; neither is a clone-only guarantee.
repair: Use the original exclusive dist/mac-{arch} output directory directly as hdiutil srcfolder. Require it contains exactly the real target App, not a symlink/foreign entries. Exclusively create the same /Applications link formerly in temp, then remove only that invocation's still-identical link. Never copy, clone, move or mutate the App. No temporary second App and no clone fallback.
